string-array.name: descriptionTricepsMedicineBallOverheadThrow
string-array.item: Medicine Ball Overhead Throw
The Medicine Ball Overhead Throw is an explosive exercise that develops power in the shoulders, triceps, and core.
To perform the exercise:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball with both hands.
2. Raise the ball overhead and engage your core.
3. Forcefully throw the ball straight down to the ground.
4. Catch the ball on the bounce or retrieve it and repeat.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Use your entire body to generate force, not just your arms.
2. Maintain a tight core to avoid straining your lower back.
3. Perform with speed but maintain control.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsOneArmTricepsPushdown
string-array.item: One Arm Triceps Pushdown
The One Arm Triceps Pushdown isolates the triceps for unilateral strength development.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a single handle to a high pulley on a cable machine.
2. Grasp the handle with one hand and stand upright.
3. Push the handle downward until your arm is fully extended.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbow stationary and close to your torso.
2. Focus on full triceps contraction at the bottom.
3. Use a controlled motion to prevent momentum.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDumbbellKickback
string-array.item: Dumbbell Kickback
The Dumbbell Kickback effectively targets the triceps by extending the arm against resistance.
To perform the exercise:
1. Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips.
2. Keep your upper arms stationary and elbows bent at 90 degrees.
3. Extend your arms straight back, fully contracting the triceps.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Avoid swinging the weights; use controlled movements.
2. Keep your core engaged to maintain stability.
3. Ensure full triceps activation by extending fully.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsOneArmReversePushdown
string-array.item: One Arm Reverse Pushdown
This variation of the triceps pushdown uses a reverse grip to target different triceps muscle fibers.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a single handle to a high pulley cable.
2. Hold the handle with an underhand grip (palm facing up).
3. Push the handle down until your arm is fully extended.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your wrist straight to avoid unnecessary strain.
2. Focus on controlled movements to maximize tension.
3. Perform with lighter weights to maintain proper form.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsPushdown
string-array.item: Push-down
The Push-down is a classic cable exercise for building triceps strength and endurance.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a straight bar or rope to the high pulley of a cable machine.
2. Stand upright and grip the bar with an overhand grip.
3. Push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows locked in place and avoid flaring them.
2. Use a moderate weight to prevent momentum.
3. Focus on squeezing the triceps at the bottom of the movement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBenchDips
string-array.item: Bench Dips
Bench Dips are an effective bodyweight exercise that targets the triceps, shoulders, and chest.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands placed next to your hips.
2. Extend your legs forward and lower your body by bending your elbows.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows pointing backward to avoid shoulder strain.
2. Lower yourself until your arms form a 90-degree angle.
3. Engage your core to maintain stability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsTricepsDips
string-array.item: Triceps Dips
Triceps Dips are a compound movement that builds upper body strength, focusing on the triceps and shoulders.
To perform the exercise:
1. Grip parallel bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
2. Lower your body by bending your elbows until your arms reach a 90-degree angle.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows tucked to fully engage the triceps.
2. Avoid swinging your legs for momentum.
3. Use controlled movements to prevent injury.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsOneArmLyingTricepsExtension
string-array.item: One Arm Lying Triceps Extension
This unilateral exercise isolates the triceps for balanced strength development.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in one hand.
2. Extend your arm straight up, then lower the dumbbell towards your forehead.
3. Push the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbow stationary to isolate the triceps.
2. Use a controlled movement to avoid hitting your head.
3. Perform equal repetitions on both arms for balance.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableRopeOverheadTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
This cable exercise provides constant tension on the triceps, maximizing activation.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a rope handle to a high pulley cable.
2. Face away from the machine and grasp the rope with both hands.
3. Extend your arms overhead, then lower the rope behind your head.
4. Push the rope back up to full extension.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your head to isolate the triceps.
2. Avoid using excessive weight that can strain your shoulders.
3. Maintain a slight forward lean for better stability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsLeverTricepsDip
string-array.item: Lever Triceps Dip
The Lever Triceps Dip is a machine-based exercise that mimics parallel bar dips but with controlled resistance.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on the machine and grasp the handles.
2. Push the handles downward until your arms are fully extended.
3. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid leaning too far forward.
2. Use a controlled motion to prevent jerking.
3. Adjust the weight to ensure proper form and full range of motion.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsLyingBarbellTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Lying Barbell Triceps Extension
This exercise, also known as the skull crusher, targets the triceps and helps build upper arm strength.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a bench and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, arms extended.
2. Lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
3. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows stationary to fully engage the triceps.
2. Use a controlled motion to prevent hitting your forehead.
3. Avoid arching your back; keep it flat on the bench.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableTricepKickback
string-array.item: Cable Tricep Kickback
A variation of the dumbbell kickback, this exercise provides continuous tension on the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a single handle to a low pulley and grasp it with one hand.
2. Bend at the waist, keeping your back straight.
3. Extend your arm fully behind you, then return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your upper arm stationary throughout the movement.
2. Use a lightweight to maintain strict form.
3. Perform equal repetitions on both arms for balance.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsTricepsDipsOnFloor
string-array.item: Triceps Dips on Floor
A bodyweight exercise that strengthens the triceps using minimal equipment.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on the floor with your knees bent and hands placed behind you.
2. Lift your hips off the floor and lower your body by bending your elbows.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows pointing backward to engage the triceps effectively.
2. Avoid locking out your elbows at the top.
3. Perform slow and controlled reps to prevent strain.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDumbbellSeatedFrontAndBackTatePress
string-array.item: Dumbbell Seated Front and Back Tate Press
This variation of the Tate Press targets the triceps from different angles for enhanced development.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on a bench holding dumbbells with a neutral grip.
2. Lower the dumbbells towards your chest, keeping elbows flared.
3. Press the dumbbells back up, alternating between the front and back of your head.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain control throughout the movement to prevent injury.
2. Use moderate weight to ensure proper form.
3. Keep your core engaged for stability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsKneelingCableTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
A cable-based exercise that isolates the triceps while minimizing momentum.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine.
2. Grip the rope with both hands and extend your arms downward.
3. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows tucked close to your body.
2. Avoid using your shoulders; focus on triceps engagement.
3. Use a slow and controlled movement to maximize effectiveness.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableRearDrive
string-array.item: Cable Rear Drive
This exercise targets the triceps while engaging the core for stability.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a straight bar to a high pulley cable machine.
2. Stand facing away from the machine, holding the bar with both hands behind your head.
3. Extend your arms forward until they are fully straightened.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows tucked in to maintain tension on the triceps.
2. Avoid using momentum; control each rep.
3. Engage your core to prevent excessive leaning.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsNarrowGripWallPushUp
string-array.item: Narrow Grip Wall Push-Up
A beginner-friendly triceps exercise using body weight.
To perform the exercise:
1. Stand facing a wall, placing your hands close together at chest level.
2. Lower your chest towards the wall by bending your elbows.
3. Push back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body for maximum triceps activation.
2. Maintain a straight line from head to heels.
3. Perform slow and controlled repetitions.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsShoulderStretchBehindBack
string-array.item: Shoulder Stretch Behind Back
A stretching exercise that improves shoulder mobility and flexibility.
To perform the exercise:
1. Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
2. Lift your hands upward while keeping your arms straight.
3. Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then release.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Avoid shrugging your shoulders; keep them relaxed.
2. Perform the stretch slowly to prevent injury.
3. Breathe deeply and hold for at least 20-30 seconds.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBodyUps
string-array.item: Body Ups
A bodyweight triceps exercise that also engages the core.
To perform the exercise:
1. Start in a forearm plank position.
2. Push up onto your hands one arm at a time.
3. Lower back down to the forearm plank.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent hip sagging.
2. Maintain a steady and controlled pace.
3. Alternate leading arms to ensure balanced development.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsWallPushUp
string-array.item: Wall Push-Up
A simple bodyweight exercise to strengthen the chest, shoulders, and triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Stand facing a wall, placing your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
2. Lean in towards the wall by bending your elbows.
3. Push back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid arching.
2. Control the movement to maximize muscle engagement.
3. Adjust hand placement for different intensity levels.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableLyingTricepsExtensions
string-array.item: Cable Lying Triceps Extensions
A variation of the skull crusher using a cable machine to maintain constant tension on the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a straight bar or rope to a low pulley cable machine.
2. Lie on a flat bench and grasp the attachment with an overhand grip.
3. Extend your arms fully, then slowly lower the bar towards your forehead.
4. Push the bar back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows stationary to isolate the triceps.
2. Avoid excessive weight to prevent strain on the elbows.
3. Use a controlled motion to maximize muscle engagement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsChairDips
string-array.item: Chair Dips
A convenient triceps exercise using a chair for resistance.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair and grip the sides.
2. Move your feet forward and lower your body by bending your elbows.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your back close to the chair.
2. Avoid locking out your elbows at the top.
3. Control the descent to prevent injury.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsSeatedOneArmDumbbellTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Seated One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
A unilateral triceps exercise to build arm strength and stability.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on a bench and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
2. Extend your arm overhead and slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head.
3. Press the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbow pointed straight up.
2. Use a moderate weight to maintain form.
3. Perform equal reps on both arms.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsSeatedDumbbellTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Seated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
A compound movement targeting all three heads of the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on a bench and hold a dumbbell with both hands.
2. Extend your arms overhead and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
3. Push the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged for stability.
2. Maintain a controlled motion throughout the movement.
3. Avoid excessive arching of the back.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsLeverTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Lever Triceps Extension
A machine-based triceps exercise providing guided resistance.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on the triceps extension machine and adjust the seat height.
2. Grip the handles and extend your arms fully.
3. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows fixed to isolate the triceps.
2. Avoid using momentum; control each rep.
3. Adjust the weight for a challenging but manageable resistance.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBenchDipsOnFloor
string-array.item: Bench Dips on Floor
A bodyweight triceps exercise that mimics traditional bench dips but performed on the floor.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on the floor with your hands behind you, fingers pointing forward.
2. Lift your hips and support your weight with your arms.
3. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body.
2. Avoid locking out your elbows at the top.
3. Engage your core for better stability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsParallelBarDips
string-array.item: Parallel Bar Dips
A compound upper-body movement that primarily targets the triceps and chest.
To perform the exercise:
1. Grip the parallel bars with your arms fully extended.
2. Lower your body by bending your elbows to 90 degrees.
3. Push back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Lean forward slightly to engage the chest or stay upright to focus on triceps.
2. Use controlled movement to avoid shoulder strain.
3. Engage your core throughout the exercise.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDumbbellSkullCrusher
string-array.item: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
A free-weight variation of the traditional skull crusher for triceps isolation.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a bench holding dumbbells with arms extended.
2. Lower the dumbbells towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
3. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows stationary to maximize triceps activation.
2. Use a slow, controlled motion to avoid injury.
3. Avoid excessive weight that may compromise form.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDumbbellInclineTwoArmExtension
string-array.item: Dumbbell Incline Two Arm Extension
A triceps isolation exercise performed on an incline bench.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells overhead.
2. Lower the dumbbells behind your head by bending your elbows.
3. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain a slow and controlled movement.
2. Keep your elbows close together to maximize triceps engagement.
3. Avoid arching your back during the movement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsOneArmPronatedDumbbellTricepsExtension
string-array.item: One Arm Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
A unilateral triceps exercise emphasizing control and stability.
To perform the exercise:
1. Hold a dumbbell in one hand with a pronated (overhand) grip.
2. Extend your arm overhead and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
3. Press the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbow stationary to isolate the triceps.
2. Use a controlled movement to prevent strain.
3. Perform equal reps on both arms.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsSeatedEZBarOverheadTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Seated EZ-Bar Overhead Triceps Extension
A strength-building exercise that targets the triceps using an EZ-bar.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on a bench with back support, holding an EZ-bar overhead.
2. Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows.
3. Extend your arms to return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close together.
2. Use a slow and controlled motion.
3. Avoid arching your back.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableInclineTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Cable Incline Triceps Extension
An isolation exercise using a cable machine to target the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on an incline bench facing away from a cable machine.
2. Hold a bar or rope attachment with arms extended.
3. Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
4. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain a slow, controlled movement.
2. Keep your elbows stationary.
3. Engage your core for stability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsReversePushUp
string-array.item: Reverse Push-Up
A bodyweight exercise that works the triceps and shoulders.
To perform the exercise:
1. Sit on the floor with your hands placed behind you, fingers facing forward.
2. Lift your hips off the ground, supporting your weight with your arms.
3. Lower yourself by bending your elbows, then push back up.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged.
2. Avoid locking out your elbows at the top.
3. Perform slow and controlled reps.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableSideTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Cable Side Triceps Extension
A unilateral exercise using a cable machine to isolate the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Stand sideways to a cable machine with a handle set at shoulder height.
2. Hold the handle with one hand and extend your arm fully.
3. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbow stationary.
2. Perform equal reps on both arms.
3. Use a moderate weight for controlled movement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsInclineEZBarTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Incline EZ-Bar Triceps Extension
A variation of the triceps extension performed on an incline bench.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on an incline bench while holding an EZ-bar overhead.
2. Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows.
3. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close together.
2. Use a controlled range of motion.
3. Avoid using excessive weight to maintain proper form.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsHighPulleyOverheadTricepExtension
string-array.item: High Pulley Overhead Tricep Extension
A cable machine exercise that effectively isolates the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Stand facing away from the cable machine with a rope or bar attachment.
2. Grip the handle with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
3. Lower the handle behind your head by bending your elbows.
4. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows stationary.
2. Use a controlled movement to avoid momentum.
3. Engage your core for stability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsRopePushdown
string-array.item: Rope Pushdown
A classic triceps isolation exercise using a cable machine and rope attachment.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a rope to the high pulley of a cable machine.
2. Stand upright and grasp the rope with both hands, palms facing inward.
3. Push the rope downward until your arms are fully extended.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body.
2. Use a full range of motion for maximum engagement.
3. Avoid swinging or using excessive momentum.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsReverseGripPushdown
string-array.item: Reverse Grip Pushdown
A variation of the triceps pushdown that emphasizes the medial head of the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a straight bar to the high pulley of a cable machine.
2. Stand upright and grasp the bar with an underhand grip (palms facing up).
3. Push the bar downward until your arms are fully extended.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows stationary throughout the movement.
2. Use a moderate weight to maintain control.
3. Engage your core for better stability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCrossArmPushUp
string-array.item: Cross Arm Push-up
A bodyweight triceps and chest exercise that requires balance and control.
To perform the exercise:
1. Get into a push-up position with your hands crossed over each other.
2. Lower your chest towards the ground while keeping your arms crossed.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged to maintain balance.
2. Use slow and controlled movements.
3. Modify by doing the exercise on your knees if needed.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableConcentrationExtensionOnKnee
string-array.item: Cable Concentration Extension on Knee
A focused triceps extension using a cable machine for isolation.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a single handle to the low pulley of a cable machine.
2. Sit on a bench and lean forward, resting your elbow on your knee.
3. Extend your arm fully, squeezing your triceps at the top.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain a controlled motion throughout.
2. Keep your elbow stationary.
3. Focus on the triceps contraction at the peak of the movement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCloseGripDumbbellPress
string-array.item: Close-Grip Dumbbell Press
A variation of the dumbbell bench press that targets the triceps more intensely.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip.
2. Press the dumbbells together and extend your arms above your chest.
3. Lower the dumbbells slowly to your chest while keeping them close together.
4. Press them back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain constant tension by keeping the dumbbells pressed together.
2. Keep your elbows tucked to engage the triceps more.
3. Control the movement to avoid bouncing the dumbbells.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsSingleDumbbellCloseGripPress
string-array.item: Single Dumbbell Close-Grip Press
A triceps-focused pressing exercise using a single dumbbell.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a bench and grip the sides of a dumbbell with both hands.
2. Hold the dumbbell over your chest with your elbows tucked in.
3. Lower the dumbbell to your chest while keeping your elbows close.
4. Press it back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged for stability.
2. Use a slow and controlled motion.
3. Focus on squeezing your triceps at the top.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsKneelingDiamondPushUp
string-array.item: Kneeling Diamond Push-Up
A beginner-friendly version of the diamond push-up that targets the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Get into a kneeling push-up position with your hands forming a diamond shape.
2. Lower your chest toward your hands, keeping your elbows close.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged.
2. Use a controlled movement to avoid straining your shoulders.
3. Gradually progress to a standard diamond push-up.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDipsBetweenChairs
string-array.item: Dips Between Chairs
A bodyweight triceps exercise using two stable chairs.
To perform the exercise:
1. Position two chairs shoulder-width apart and grip the edges.
2. Lift your body off the ground with straight arms.
3. Lower yourself by bending your elbows until they reach a 90-degree angle.
4. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows tucked in to target the triceps.
2. Use sturdy chairs to ensure stability.
3. Avoid going too low to prevent shoulder strain.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableOneArmOverheadTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Cable One-Arm Overhead Triceps Extension
An isolation exercise for the triceps using a cable machine.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a single handle to the low pulley of a cable machine.
2. Grab the handle with one hand and lift it overhead.
3. Extend your arm fully, then slowly lower it back down.
4. Repeat for the desired reps and switch arms.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbow stationary.
2. Use a light weight to maintain control.
3. Focus on a full range of motion.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsStandingBarbellTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Standing Barbell Triceps Extension
A compound triceps exercise using a barbell for maximum resistance.
To perform the exercise:
1. Stand upright and grip a barbell with both hands, positioning it behind your head.
2. Keep your elbows close to your ears and extend your arms fully.
3. Slowly lower the barbell back behind your head.
4. Repeat for the desired number of reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain a firm grip on the barbell.
2. Avoid flaring your elbows to keep tension on the triceps.
3. Use controlled movements to prevent injury.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsImpossibleDips
string-array.item: Impossible Dips
An advanced dip variation that requires significant upper body strength.
To perform the exercise:
1. Position yourself on parallel bars or dip bars.
2. Lean forward slightly and lower your body slowly.
3. Pause at the bottom, then push yourself back up.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your movement controlled.
2. Engage your triceps and shoulders throughout.
3. Avoid excessive swinging.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsKoreanDips
string-array.item: Korean Dips
A challenging dip variation that places greater emphasis on the posterior chain.
To perform the exercise:
1. Get into a dip position with your hands gripping a bar behind you.
2. Lower your body while keeping your legs extended forward.
3. Push yourself back up while maintaining form.
4. Repeat for the desired number of reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Engage your core for stability.
2. Keep your movements slow and controlled.
3. Start with standard dips before attempting this variation.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsStraightBarDip
string-array.item: Straight Bar Dip
A dip variation using a straight bar to challenge stability and strength.
To perform the exercise:
1. Position yourself above a straight bar with both hands gripping it.
2. Lower your body while keeping your chest slightly forward.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows tucked in.
2. Maintain a strong grip to avoid slipping.
3. Engage your core to help with balance.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsExerciseBallTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Exercise Ball Triceps Extension
A stability-focused triceps extension using an exercise ball.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on an exercise ball with your feet firmly on the ground.
2. Hold a dumbbell in both hands and extend your arms overhead.
3. Lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your elbows stable.
4. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Engage your core for balance.
2. Use a controlled motion to prevent instability.
3. Start with a light dumbbell and gradually increase weight.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDumbbellDeclineOneArmHammerPress
string-array.item: Dumbbell Decline One-Arm Hammer Press
A unilateral chest and triceps exercise performed on a decline bench.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a decline bench, holding a dumbbell in a neutral grip.
2. Lower the dumbbell slowly to your chest while keeping your elbow close to your body.
3. Press the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired reps, then switch arms.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain control throughout the movement.
2. Engage your core to stabilize your body.
3. Use a weight that allows for proper form.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsTricepsExtensionMachine
string-array.item: Triceps Extension Machine
A machine-based exercise that isolates the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Adjust the seat and select an appropriate weight.
2. Grip the handles and press down, fully extending your arms.
3. Slowly return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows stationary.
2. Avoid using momentum to lift the weight.
3. Control the movement to maximize muscle engagement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsTricepsDipMachine
string-array.item: Triceps Dip Machine
A machine-assisted dip variation that targets the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Adjust the seat and select an appropriate weight.
2. Grip the handles and push down, extending your arms.
3. Slowly return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows tucked in.
2. Maintain control throughout the movement.
3. Avoid locking out your elbows at the top.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsSingleArmPushUp
string-array.item: Single Arm Push-Up
An advanced bodyweight exercise that challenges upper body strength.
To perform the exercise:
1. Assume a standard push-up position but keep one arm behind your back.
2. Lower your body slowly while keeping your core tight.
3. Push back up to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired reps, then switch arms.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain a strong core to prevent rotation.
2. Perform the exercise on an elevated surface if needed.
3. Engage your entire body for stability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsWallSupportedHandstandPushUps
string-array.item: Wall-Supported Handstand Push-Ups
A challenging push-up variation that builds shoulder and triceps strength.
To perform the exercise:
1. Kick up into a handstand position against a wall.
2. Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your head nearly touches the ground.
3. Press back up to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged for balance.
2. Control the descent to avoid injury.
3. Use a soft surface under your head for safety.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsTowelShoulderStretch
string-array.item: Towel Shoulder Stretch
A flexibility exercise that targets the shoulders and triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Hold a towel behind your back with one hand overhead and the other behind your lower back.
2. Gently pull the towel upward with your top hand to stretch the lower shoulder.
3. Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
4. Switch arms and repeat.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your spine straight throughout the stretch.
2. Do not force the movement; stretch gently.
3. Breathe deeply to enhance relaxation.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDeclineCloseGripBenchToSkullCrusher
string-array.item: Decline Close-Grip Bench To Skull Crusher
A compound triceps exercise that combines pressing and extension movements.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a decline bench and grip the barbell with a close grip.
2. Lower the bar to your lower chest and press it back up.
3. After pressing, transition into a skull crusher by lowering the bar toward your forehead.
4. Extend your arms back to the starting position and repeat.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows tucked to engage the triceps.
2. Use a controlled motion to avoid injury.
3. Select a weight that allows for proper form.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBarbellOneArmFloorPress
string-array.item: Barbell One-Arm Floor Press
A unilateral pressing exercise that targets the chest and triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on the floor and hold a barbell with one hand.
2. Press the barbell upward until your arm is fully extended.
3. Lower the barbell slowly until your upper arm touches the floor.
4. Repeat for the desired reps and switch arms.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged for stability.
2. Control the movement to prevent imbalances.
3. Use a spotter if lifting heavy weights.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsAssistedTricepsDips
string-array.item: Assisted Triceps Dips
A machine-assisted exercise that helps build triceps strength.
To perform the exercise:
1. Set the weight on the dip assist machine.
2. Grip the dip bars and place your knees on the support pad.
3. Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your arms are at a 90-degree angle.
4. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
2. Control the descent to avoid straining your shoulders.
3. Adjust the weight to match your strength level.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsReactionBallThrow
string-array.item: Reaction Ball Throw
A dynamic exercise that improves hand-eye coordination and reaction time.
To perform the exercise:
1. Hold a reaction ball and throw it against a wall or the floor.
2. React quickly to catch the ball as it bounces unpredictably.
3. Repeat for multiple repetitions.
4. Adjust the distance and force for added challenge.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Stay light on your feet for quick movements.
2. Keep your eyes focused on the ball at all times.
3. Use both hands to balance training intensity.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsStandingTricepsStretch
string-array.item: Standing Triceps Stretch
A flexibility exercise that helps loosen the triceps and shoulders.
To perform the exercise:
1. Stand tall and raise one arm overhead.
2. Bend your elbow, bringing your hand behind your head.
3. Use the opposite hand to gently pull the elbow further back.
4. Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid arching.
2. Stretch gently without forcing the movement.
3. Breathe deeply to enhance relaxation.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsForearmPushUp
string-array.item: Forearm Push-Up
A bodyweight exercise that strengthens the triceps, shoulders, and core.
To perform the exercise:
1. Get into a forearm plank position with your elbows under your shoulders.
2. Push through your forearms to lift your upper body slightly.
3. Lower back down under control.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core tight to prevent sagging.
2. Use a controlled motion to maximize muscle engagement.
3. Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsEZBarBentArmPullover
string-array.item: EZ-Bar Bent Arm Pullover
A compound exercise that targets the triceps, chest, and lats.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a bench and hold an EZ-bar with a shoulder-width grip.
2. Lower the bar in an arc behind your head, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
3. Bring the bar back to the starting position above your chest.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce joint strain.
2. Use a controlled motion to prevent excessive shoulder stress.
3. Engage your core to stabilize your body on the bench.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsLowCableTricepKickback
string-array.item: Low Cable Tricep Kickback
An isolation exercise for the triceps using a cable machine.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a handle to the low pulley of a cable machine.
2. Bend forward slightly and hold the handle with one hand.
3. Extend your arm backward until it is fully straight.
4. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbow close to your torso.
2. Use a slow and controlled movement.
3. Avoid swinging the weight; focus on muscle contraction.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBandSkullCrusher
string-array.item: Band Skull Crusher
A resistance band variation of the skull crusher targeting the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Anchor a resistance band at a low position.
2. Lie on a bench or the floor and hold the band handles.
3. Extend your arms upward, then slowly lower your hands towards your forehead.
4. Press back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows fixed in place.
2. Maintain control of the band tension throughout the movement.
3. Avoid using momentum; focus on muscle engagement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBandPushdown
string-array.item: Band Pushdown
A resistance band exercise that isolates the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Anchor a resistance band at a high position.
2. Grasp the band with both hands and stand upright.
3. Push the band downward until your arms are fully extended.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body.
2. Control the movement and avoid using momentum.
3. Use a band with appropriate resistance for your strength level.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDeclineDumbbellTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Decline Dumbbell Triceps Extension
An advanced triceps isolation exercise performed on a decline bench.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a decline bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Extend your arms straight above your chest.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells towards your forehead.
4. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows stationary to focus on the triceps.
2. Use a controlled movement to avoid strain.
3. Avoid locking out your elbows at the top of the movement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDumbbellTatePress
string-array.item: Dumbbell Tate Press
A triceps exercise that also engages the chest muscles.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Extend your arms straight above your chest.
3. Lower the dumbbells towards your chest by bending your elbows outward.
4. Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep the dumbbells close together during the movement.
2. Use a slow and controlled motion.
3. Avoid excessive weight to prevent elbow strain.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsHandstandPushupsBetweenBenches
string-array.item: Handstand Push-ups Between Benches
An advanced bodyweight exercise that strengthens the shoulders and triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Place two benches close together and position yourself in a handstand between them.
2. Lower your body by bending your elbows until your head reaches below the bench level.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Ensure stability of the benches before starting.
2. Engage your core to maintain balance.
3. Only attempt if you have sufficient upper body strength.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsKippingHandstandPushup
string-array.item: Kipping Handstand Push-up
A dynamic variation of the handstand push-up using momentum from the legs.
To perform the exercise:
1. Kick up into a handstand position against a wall.
2. Lower your head towards the ground by bending your elbows.
3. Explosively kick your legs upward while pressing back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Use your legs to generate momentum.
2. Keep your core tight for stability.
3. Ensure a controlled descent to prevent injury.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBentOverKickback
string-array.item: Bent Over Kickback
A triceps isolation exercise performed in a bent-over position.
To perform the exercise:
1. Hold a dumbbell in each hand and bend forward at the hips.
2. Keep your upper arms parallel to your torso.
3. Extend your arms straight back, fully contracting the triceps.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows stationary throughout the movement.
2. Use controlled motion and avoid swinging the weights.
3. Maintain a neutral spine to avoid lower back strain.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCloseGripBenchPress
string-array.item: Close Grip Bench Press
A compound exercise that targets the triceps and chest.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a flat bench and grip the barbell with hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Lower the bar to your chest while keeping your elbows close to your body.
3. Press the bar back up to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your wrists straight to avoid strain.
2. Engage your triceps by maintaining a close grip.
3. Avoid flaring your elbows to prevent shoulder injury.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDumbbellTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Dumbbell Triceps Extension
An isolation exercise for the triceps performed with dumbbells.
To perform the exercise:
1. Hold a dumbbell with both hands and raise it overhead.
2. Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
3. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your head.
2. Use a controlled motion to avoid strain.
3. Choose an appropriate weight to maintain proper form.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsDiamondPushup
string-array.item: Diamond Push-up
A bodyweight exercise that targets the triceps and chest.
To perform the exercise:
1. Assume a push-up position with your hands forming a diamond shape under your chest.
2. Lower your body until your chest nearly touches your hands.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired reps.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body.
2. Engage your core for stability.
3. Perform the movement slowly for maximum muscle activation.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsTricepsExtensionWithResistanceBands
string-array.item: Triceps Extension with Resistance Bands
An effective exercise for building triceps strength using resistance bands.
To perform the exercise:
1. Anchor a resistance band at a high position.
2. Hold the band with both hands and position your elbows close to your head.
3. Extend your arms straight to fully contract the triceps.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain controlled movement to prevent excessive momentum.
2. Keep your elbows stationary to isolate the triceps.
3. Adjust the band\'s resistance based on your strength level.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsAlternatingLyingDumbbellTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Alternating Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extension
An isolation exercise that targets the triceps while lying on a bench.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a flat bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Extend both arms straight up.
3. Lower one dumbbell towards your head by bending your elbow.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat with the other arm.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows stationary throughout the movement.
2. Use a controlled motion to avoid strain.
3. Avoid excessive arching of your back.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBarbellReverseGripSkullcrusher
string-array.item: Barbell Reverse Grip Skullcrusher
A variation of the skull crusher exercise that uses a reverse grip for increased triceps activation.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a bench, holding a barbell with a reverse (underhand) grip.
2. Extend your arms straight above your head.
3. Lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
4. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows in a fixed position.
2. Use a controlled movement to prevent injury.
3. Choose an appropriate weight to maintain proper form.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBarbellLyingBackOfTheHeadTricepExtension
string-array.item: Barbell Lying Back of the Head Tricep Extension
A barbell exercise that isolates the triceps by lowering the weight behind the head.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a flat bench, holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
2. Extend your arms straight above your chest.
3. Lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
4. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows stationary throughout the movement.
2. Avoid using excessive weight to prevent injury.
3. Maintain a slow and controlled motion.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsEZBarLyingCloseGripTricepsExtensionBehindHead
string-array.item: EZ Bar Lying Close Grip Triceps Extension Behind Head
A triceps exercise performed with an EZ bar for reduced wrist strain.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a bench and hold an EZ bar with a close grip.
2. Extend your arms straight above your chest.
3. Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows.
4. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your head.
2. Use a controlled motion to prevent strain.
3. Avoid arching your back excessively.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsKneelingCableTricepsExtension2
string-array.item: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
A cable machine exercise that isolates the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a rope or bar to the high pulley of a cable machine.
2. Kneel on the floor and hold the attachment with both hands.
3. Extend your arms forward while keeping your elbows stationary.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged for stability.
2. Avoid using momentum to complete the movement.
3. Use a full range of motion for maximum triceps activation.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCloseGripReverseBenchPress
string-array.item: Close-Grip Reverse Bench Press
A bench press variation that emphasizes the triceps and upper chest by using a reverse grip.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on a bench and grip the barbell with a close, underhand grip.
2. Lower the barbell slowly to your lower chest.
3. Press the barbell back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your torso.
2. Use a controlled motion to avoid wrist strain.
3. Maintain a firm grip to prevent instability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsOneArmHighPulleyOverheadTricepExtension
string-array.item: One Arm High Pulley Overhead Tricep Extension
A cable machine exercise that isolates one arm at a time for triceps activation.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a single handle to the high pulley of a cable machine.
2. Stand with your back to the machine and grasp the handle with one hand.
3. Extend your arm overhead, keeping your elbow stationary.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged for stability.
2. Avoid using momentum to complete the movement.
3. Use a full range of motion for maximum triceps engagement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableCrossoverTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Cable Crossover Triceps Extension
A triceps isolation exercise using cables in a crossover position.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach handles to the high pulleys of a cable crossover machine.
2. Stand in the center, grasping each handle with the opposite hand.
3. Extend your arms downward, keeping your elbows fixed.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain an upright posture.
2. Keep your elbows close to your body.
3. Avoid excessive swinging of the arms.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsSideOneArmReversePushdown
string-array.item: Side One Arm Reverse Pushdown
A unilateral triceps pushdown variation with a reverse grip for focused engagement.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a single handle to a high pulley.
2. Stand sideways to the cable machine and grasp the handle with an underhand grip.
3. Extend your arm downward while keeping your elbow stationary.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Use a light weight to maintain control.
2. Keep your wrist straight throughout the movement.
3. Focus on squeezing the triceps at the bottom of the movement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBodyweightSkullCrushers
string-array.item: Bodyweight Skull Crushers
A bodyweight triceps exercise that mimics the skull crusher movement without weights.
To perform the exercise:
1. Place your hands on a stable elevated surface, such as parallel bars or a bench.
2. Lean forward and lower your forehead towards your hands by bending your elbows.
3. Push back up to the starting position.
4. Keep your body in a straight line throughout the movement.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged for stability.
2. Avoid flaring your elbows out.
3. Perform the movement slowly to maximize muscle engagement.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsVBarPushdown
string-array.item: V-Bar Pushdown
A cable exercise that targets the triceps using a V-bar attachment for a strong grip and controlled movement.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a V-bar to the high pulley of a cable machine.
2. Stand upright and grasp the bar with an overhand grip.
3. Push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body.
2. Avoid using momentum—control the movement.
3. Engage your core for stability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableRopeLyingTricepExtension
string-array.item: Cable Rope Lying Tricep Extension
A cable variation of the skull crusher that provides continuous tension on the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a rope to the low pulley of a cable machine.
2. Lie on a bench and grasp the rope with both hands.
3. Extend your arms fully while keeping your elbows stationary.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain control throughout the movement.
2. Keep your elbows locked in place.
3. Avoid arching your back.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCableLyingTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
A cable-based alternative to traditional triceps extensions, offering controlled resistance.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a straight or EZ bar to a low pulley.
2. Lie on a bench and grasp the bar with both hands.
3. Lower the bar towards your forehead while keeping your elbows fixed.
4. Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your movements slow and controlled.
2. Avoid excessive weight to prevent strain.
3. Engage your core for stability.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsStraddlePlanche
string-array.item: Straddle Planche
An advanced bodyweight exercise that heavily engages the triceps, shoulders, and core.
To perform the exercise:
1. Place your hands on the ground, shoulder-width apart.
2. Lean forward and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straddled.
3. Balance on your hands, maintaining a straight-arm position.
4. Hold for as long as possible before lowering back down.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Engage your core to maintain balance.
2. Keep your elbows locked.
3. Start with progressions if needed.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCloseGripKneePushUp
string-array.item: Close-Grip Knee Push-Up
A beginner-friendly push-up variation that targets the triceps and chest.
To perform the exercise:
1. Get into a modified push-up position with your knees on the ground.
2. Place your hands close together under your chest.
3. Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor.
4. Push back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your torso.
2. Maintain a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
3. Control the descent and push explosively upward.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsSupineMedicineBallChestThrow
string-array.item: Supine Medicine Ball Chest Throw
An explosive exercise that strengthens the chest and triceps while improving power.
To perform the exercise:
1. Lie on your back with a medicine ball held at chest level.
2. Extend your arms forcefully, throwing the ball straight up.
3. Catch the ball on the way down and immediately repeat.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Use a medicine ball of appropriate weight to maintain control.
2. Engage your core for stability.
3. Perform in a safe area to avoid injury.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsReverseDips
string-array.item: Reverse Dips
A triceps and shoulder exercise performed using parallel bars or a bench.
To perform the exercise:
1. Position yourself between parallel bars or place hands on a bench behind you.
2. Lower your body by bending your elbows until your arms are at 90 degrees.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your back close to the bench if using one.
2. Engage your triceps and avoid excessive swinging.
3. Use slow, controlled movements.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsPlanchePushUp
string-array.item: Planche Push-Up
An advanced bodyweight exercise that heavily engages the triceps, shoulders, and core.
To perform the exercise:
1. Assume a push-up position with hands placed below your shoulders.
2. Lean forward, shifting your body weight onto your hands.
3. Lower your chest towards the ground while keeping your legs off the floor.
4. Push back up while maintaining balance.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core engaged to prevent loss of balance.
2. Start with progressions if needed.
3. Avoid locking your elbows to prevent strain.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsArcherPushUp
string-array.item: Archer Push-Up
A unilateral push-up variation that enhances strength and control in the triceps and chest.
To perform the exercise:
1. Assume a standard push-up position with hands placed wider than shoulder-width apart.
2. Lower your chest towards one hand while keeping the other arm extended.
3. Push back up and repeat on the opposite side.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your core tight and body aligned.
2. Move in a controlled manner to avoid injury.
3. Gradually increase the range of motion as you progress.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsRingDips
string-array.item: Ring Dips
An advanced triceps and shoulder exercise performed using gymnastic rings.
To perform the exercise:
1. Grip the rings and lift yourself to a support position.
2. Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
3. Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Engage your core to maintain stability.
2. Avoid excessive swinging.
3. Use slow and controlled movements to prevent injury.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsSingleArmRaisePushUp
string-array.item: Single Arm Raise Push-up
An advanced push-up variation that challenges core stability and shoulder strength by adding an arm raise.
This exercise develops anti-rotation core strength while increasing pushing power.
To perform the exercise:
1. Begin in standard push-up position
2. Lower body with control
3. As you push up, lift one arm straight forward
4. Hold briefly then return arm and repeat
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep hips parallel to ground
2. Engage entire core to prevent rotation
3. Start with short holds (1-2 seconds)
4. Alternate arms for balanced development

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsSuspendedPushUp
string-array.item: Suspended Push-Up
A challenging push-up variation using suspension trainers to increase instability and core engagement.
The unstable surface forces greater muscle recruitment throughout the kinetic chain.
To perform the exercise:
1. Adjust straps to mid-length and grip handles
2. Assume push-up position with feet on ground
3. Lower chest between hands with control
4. Push back up to starting position
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep body in straight line throughout
2. Start with feet wide for stability
3. Progress to narrower stance as you improve
4. Focus on slow, controlled movements

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsCloseGripDumbbellPushUp
string-array.item: Close-grip Dumbbell Push-Up
A triceps-focused push-up variation performed with dumbbells to increase range of motion.
The neutral grip reduces wrist strain while emphasizing triceps development.
To perform the exercise:
1. Place dumbbells close together in push-up position
2. Keep elbows tucked close to body
3. Lower chest between dumbbells
4. Press back up to starting position
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain straight body alignment
2. Squeeze dumbbells together for stability
3. Focus on full range of motion
4. Can be progressed to renegade rows

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsMedicineBallPushUp
string-array.item: Medicine Ball Push-Up
An unstable push-up variation that increases core activation and shoulder stability.
The medicine ball creates an unstable surface that challenges proprioception.
To perform the exercise:
1. Place one hand on medicine ball, other on floor
2. Maintain straight body line
3. Lower chest with control
4. Push back up and switch hands
Tips for proper execution:
1. Start with larger ball for stability
2. Progress to smaller balls as you improve
3. Keep shoulders level throughout
4. Engage core to prevent sagging

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsSingleArmPushUpOnMedicineBall
string-array.item: Single Arm Push-Up on Medicine Ball
An advanced unilateral pushing exercise combining instability with single-arm strength.
Develops exceptional core stability and shoulder strength simultaneously.
To perform the exercise:
1. Place one hand on medicine ball in push-up position
2. Place other hand behind back
3. Lower with control maintaining straight body
4. Push back up and switch sides
Tips for proper execution:
1. Master regular single-arm push-ups first
2. Use larger ball initially for stability
3. Keep feet wide for balance
4. Focus on quality over quantity

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsRearDriveWithResistanceBand
string-array.item: Rear Drive With Resistance Band
An exercise that targets the triceps and posterior shoulder muscles using a resistance band.
To perform the exercise:
1. Attach a resistance band to a fixed point at chest height.
2. Stand facing away from the anchor point and hold the band with both hands.
3. Extend your arms backward, keeping them straight.
4. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Maintain a slight forward lean to maximize tension.
2. Keep your core engaged for stability.
3. Perform slow, controlled movements.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsStandingTricepsExtensionGymstick
string-array.item: Standing Triceps Extension | Gymstick
A resistance band exercise that focuses on the triceps.
To perform the exercise:
1. Step on the Gymstick band with both feet and hold the stick behind your head.
2. Extend your arms overhead, straightening them fully.
3. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your head.
2. Avoid arching your lower back.
3. Control the movement to prevent jerking.

string-array.name: descriptionTricepsBandedOverheadTricepsExtension
string-array.item: Banded Overhead Triceps Extension
A triceps-focused exercise performed with a resistance band.
To perform the exercise:
1. Secure the band under your feet and hold the other end behind your head.
2. Extend your arms fully overhead.
3. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows in a fixed position.
2. Engage your core to prevent leaning backward.
3. Perform slow, controlled reps.

string-array.item: Overhead Triceps Extension | Gymstick
A triceps isolation exercise using the Gymstick.
To perform the exercise:
1. Stand on the Gymstick band and hold the stick behind your head.
2. Extend your arms overhead until they are fully straight.
3. Slowly return to the starting position.
Tips for proper execution:
1. Keep your elbows close to your head.
2. Avoid using momentum to lift the weight.
3. Maintain a steady and controlled movement.
